metadata.description: Jacqueline Dean's Claude Code plugins: agent extensions for engineering leadership work.

plugins.name: impact-review
plugins.description: Turn GitHub activity for one person, a team, an organization or an enterprise, over any timeframe, into metrics, a dashboard, a rubric-based review, highlight bullets and STAR stories.

plugins.name: chronicle
plugins.description: Illustrated, interactive story pages (Artifacts) designed for their subject, and painted or drawn animations in the same style: status stories, launches, onboarding handbooks, field guides with rigged animals, map tours and rooms, gamified training and podcast companions, from a brief, the material a researcher digests, and company facts through the sources plugin.

plugins.name: sources
plugins.description: Read-only access to GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Databricks, Postgres and Oracle for pages that present data: a gatherer subagent and script collectors write facts with the query behind each number, behind a SQL guard and read-only sessions, and /sources:connect sets up each system.

plugins.name: briefing
plugins.description: Slide decks and KPI dashboards from facts as Artifacts: 16:9 slides with builds, notes and stepped animations, and dashboards with targets, status by rule, filters and the query behind every number; a brand kit, refresh with no model call, and exports to claude.ai Slides and Dashboard, Google Drive, Microsoft 365, PDF and PNG.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Interactive system and data design visuals and prototypes: technical architecture diagrams laid out in code, sequence diagrams and ERDs played step by step, pages with part details, pins and a step player, ERDs read live from Postgres or Oracle, Unity Catalog lineage, and clickable prototype screens fed by facts.

plugins.name: speedup
plugins.description: Continuous performance optimization from Datadog, Prometheus or imported data: p75 user journeys against targets, proxy benchmarks whose CI ceilings only move down, a change ledger with measured effects, a dashboard Artifact and an optional blog-style write-up.
